tools.name: search_machines
tools.description: Find local AI computers and graphics cards by budget, memory and type. Returns price, measured tok/s, value (tok/s per 1,000 of currency), when the price was checked, and the page URL. Prices are checked once a day.

tools.name: get_machine
tools.description: One machine in full by id (from search_machines) or page URL: price per store with stock and check time, price history summary, every published speed result with its source, and value.

tools.name: find_for_model
tools.description: Which tracked machines can run an open model (4-bit weights fit in memory), cheapest first, with measured tok/s where someone has published a result. Use list_models for ids.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Price drops, price rises, restocks and newly tracked machines, newest first. Set since to a timestamp and only later changes come back; reuse next_since from the reply for the next call. Prices are checked once a day.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The open models we track: id, size, memory needed at 4-bit and 8-bit, how many machines fit each and how many have a measured speed, and the page URL.
